responsibility: Autoconf input for the GNU Modula-2 driver/config header that probes host facilities used by gm2spec.cc and related support code. It canonicalizes build/host/target tuples, checks for functions and directory-handling headers such as stpcpy and opendir support, and emits gm2config.aci via AC_CONFIG_HEADERS, making it the source of the gm2-specific configure tests rather than the top-level GCC configure logic.
